remarks: This beautifully renovated three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath townhouse-style half duplex is ideally located in the heart of Stamford-just a 12-minute walk to Stamford Main Train Station and only 45 minutes to New York City. Offering unmatched convenience, this home is close to the city's top dining, shopping, and entertainment destinations.  The main level features a bright and spacious living room, a dedicated dining area, a breakfast bar, and a convenient half bath-perfect for everyday living and entertaining.  Upstairs, the generous primary suite includes a walk-in closet and a full en-suite bathroom. Two additional well-sized bedrooms with hardwood floors share a second full bath. Fresh paint and updated finishes throughout the upper level add to the home's modern charm.  The lower level offers in-unit laundry hookups and ample storage space, providing excellent functionality and convenience.  Excellent credit history is required.
